title: Withdrawal Refund Schedule for Tailwise Training Courses and Packs
content:
# Withdrawal Refund Schedule — Tailwise Training

The figures that govern a refund when a customer withdraws from a Tailwise Training course or pack.

| Course or pack | Full refund of the price paid for withdrawal before the first session | Session number before which a withdrawal earns a prorated refund | Refund per unused session after start (USD) | Fee withheld from a refund after the first session (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Puppy Training 6-Week Group | Yes | 2 | 0.00 | 15.00 |
| Adult Basic Training 6-Week Group | Yes | 2 | 0.00 | 15.00 |
| Intermediate Training 6-Week Group | Yes | 2 | 0.00 | 15.00 |
| Advanced Training & CGC Prep 6-Week Group | Yes | 2 | 0.00 | 15.00 |
| Private Training 4-Session Pack | Yes | 0 | 59.00 | 25.00 |
| Private Training 8-Session Pack | Yes | 0 | 54.00 | 25.00 |

### Column notes

- **Full refund before the first session.** Every course and pack refunds the full price paid when the withdrawal comes before the first session.
- **Prorated-refund session number.** The last session number before which a group course withdrawal earns a prorated refund: session 2 on all four group courses. A figure of 0 means no prorated refund after start; the private packs show 0 because they are refunded per unused session instead.
- **Refund per unused session.** The amount refunded for each unused session once a private pack has started: 59.00 on the Private Training 4-Session Pack and 54.00 on the Private Training 8-Session Pack. The group courses show 0.00, because a group course refund is a share of the price paid, not a per-session rate.
- **Fee withheld.** The administration fee withheld from a refund after the first session: 15.00 on each group course and 25.00 on each private pack.
